name: Intrusion Detection System
description: An intrusion detection system (IDS) — also called IPS, network/host intrusion detection, NIDS/HIDS, Snort/Suricata, or anomaly detection — a control that monitors network and host activity for known-malicious or anomalous patterns and raises alerts. The place to look for IDS/IPS, intrusion detection, network anomaly monitoring, or signature/behavior-based attack detection.
